technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish technicals (RSI, Supertrend, OBV) offset by weak trend structure (low ADX), overbought conditions, and price below key moving averages—moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IRM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 16 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (24/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (327), strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings event in 16 days compounds volatility risk for IRM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technicals (RSI 9 bullish, Supertrend bullish, OBV bullish) combined with extreme fear sentiment (24/100) and price near support (39.72) create a contrarian entry opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), high earnings risk in 16 days, overbought oscillators (Stoch RSI, Williams %R), price below EMA 50, weak ADX trend structure, and zero fundamental catalysts make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: While short-term technicals (RSI 9, Supertrend, OBV) show bullish momentum and extreme fear sentiment (24/100) presents contrarian opportunity, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) combined with high earnings risk in 16 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 16 days will likely trigger sharp volatility; macro recession signals (inverted curve, VIX 327) amplify downside risk if fundamentals disappoint.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding IRM position with 18 other Real Estate positions (7% sector concentration); adding to existing IRM exposure during earnings blackout window and macro crisis contradicts prudent concentration management.
